What actually makes a connection thrive, in my view, is two distinct people who like each other and can disagree without it breaking anything.

So I won't promise to be more agreeable. But I will promise you this: I'll always tell you what I actually think, and I'll do it with care. You get my real opinion, delivered kindly — not a version of me that's been sanded down. If that's a dealbreaker, I'd rather know now than pretend otherwise.
